title: Dxcufgb's lively tokens
description: Cinematic animated rings around tokens: 18 designs (Druid, Magic Smoke, Chains, Clockwork, Swirling Flame, Glyphs, God Rays, Leaves & Petals, Particles, Wormholes, Storm, Frost, Tide, Arcane Ward, Bard's Song, Charm, Necrotic, Orbiting Stones) with several styles each. Stack several into one ring, use your own images, add glow, pulse, rainbow and spin, and save your combinations. Live preview window, Token Controls button and character sheet entry.
